warmup_description: linear first55 of550 optimizer updates, first LR=base/55 then constant; no further search
evaluation: training pool only, fixed final epoch25; log epochs1/5/10/15/20/25; no validation/test access or selection
primary_metric: per-RNA macro train F1 with existing decoder/threshold0.5
cnn_baseline: read prior CNN checkpoints, evaluate training only, no CNN lr search
stop_rule: If each of the three encoders has every completed final-epoch run below0.8, stop tuning and report insufficient fitting. Failures reported separately, not assigned invented F1.
acceptance_gate: Only reopen validation comparison after every encoder has a single variant with all3 seeds final train F1>=0.9, including saved CNN baseline. This is necessary training-comparability evidence, not sufficient proof of causal architecture generalization.
bounded_scope: Run these36 training jobs only; no additional LR/depth/LayerNorm/warmup searches. If strict stop not triggered but acceptance gate closed, still stop this requested scan and report mixed thresholds.
parameter_changes: lr and specified warmup only; all encoder, geometry, loss and data definitions unchanged.
